entries: **Quota-aware mode tells Claude once per conversation when new models or Antigravity quota groups appear.** When a new model or Antigravity quota group shows up in the last seven days, Claude hears about it once per conversation along with whether usage's price table knows it yet. New Codex models are picked up from Codex's own model list; models from other tools appear after you use them once.

**The Antigravity CLI recovers automatically after a temporary sign-out error.** When a background CLI check fails once with an authentication error and locks the gate, if the fallback quota check still succeeds with the same credential after six hours, usage clears the marker and resumes using the CLI.

**The Antigravity window keeper also stops launching sign-in pages after a timed-out ping.** When the auto-start ping times out while waiting on an authentication prompt, usage now records the CLI as signed out just like the quota check does.
**The Antigravity sign-out marker is now written atomically.** Concurrent reads by the window keeper can no longer see a half-written file and accidentally reopen the CLI gate.

**A Gemini weekly quota close to its reset is no longer mistaken for the 5-hour quota.** After a CLI check has recorded the weekly reset time, a fallback check whose reset estimate lands within ten minutes of that weekly reset now updates the weekly row instead of duplicating the number into the 5-hour row.

**Earlier Antigravity days in the year view update to the corrected numbers.** The saved daily history used to replace a day only when the recalculated total was at least as large, so days recorded before the Antigravity token and pricing fixes stayed stuck at the old inflated totals. After updating, those earlier days switch to the corrected numbers as long as all of that day's conversation logs and sessions are still on disk; days with missing history keep their saved totals.

**Antigravity thinking tokens are included in report totals and cost.** After output and thinking tokens were separated, Antigravity thinking tokens were left out of the report's output count and cost calculation. Thinking tokens are now billed at the output rate, matching Codex. Antigravity cost in the report will be noticeably higher: that is the share that was missing before, not a price change.

**Failed price table downloads wait 10 minutes before retrying.** When offline or behind a blocked network with an expired or missing price cache, each cost calculation started a new download attempt. usage now waits 10 minutes after a failed download before trying again.

**Replaced price tables are no longer kept in memory.** When the price table was refreshed repeatedly in a long-running menu bar session, earlier tables stayed cached in memory. usage now clears old lookup entries whenever a new price table takes effect.

**Muse Wonder and Muse Ember are priced in the HTML report.** The offline price table only knew Muse Spark, so tokens from `muse-wonder-1.0` and `muse-ember-1.0` sessions were listed as unpriced whenever the downloaded table had no Meta entries. Both now carry Meta's published standard-mode prices; Ember's long-context tier (over 200K input tokens per request) is not told apart because session logs do not record it.

**Quota-aware mode keeps working across multiple conversations on the same Claude Code account.** When another conversation on the same account updates the status file last, existing conversations still receive Claude Code quota warnings and new conversations get their starting overview without waiting. After a `/login` switch in one conversation, idle conversations that switch later no longer mistake the already-updated numbers for the old account's limits.

**Quota-aware mode handles non-ASCII text on Windows, cleans up failed state writes, and stops adding unrelated Antigravity group notes.** It now reads stdin and writes stdout as UTF-8 instead of the system code page so CJK text no longer silences it or desynchronizes saved state from output, and removes its temporary file if saving state fails. The "Other agy model groups still have quota" line now appears only on turns that actually report an Antigravity model group crossing a threshold.

**Antigravity usage is priced again in the HTML report.** The model IDs that Antigravity now records (such as `gemini-4-argon-s`, `gemini-3.8-flash-n` and `claude-sonnet-5-5-medium`) matched no entry in the price table, so all Antigravity tokens were listed as unpriced. usage now drops Antigravity's own suffixes (`-n`, `-s`, `-trial`, `-tiered`, `-low`, `-medium`, `-high`, `-xhigh`) and also looks up `gemini/`-prefixed prices. Gemini 4 Hydrogen is priced too.

**The Antigravity status line names the `xhigh` effort level.** Gemini 4 Hydrogen at `xhigh` used to show the raw English name. It now shows a localized label like the other levels, such as `Extended` in English.

**Antigravity token counts are read from the right fields.** usage added Antigravity's internal model ID (about 1,300–1,500) to the input tokens of every response, so Antigravity input was overcounted. It also swapped output and thinking tokens. Input now comes only from the input field, thinking and output are no longer swapped, and responses that carry nothing but the model ID are no longer counted. Cached Antigravity results are rebuilt once after updating.
